title: AUREN Global Development Finance, SME and Export Finance Sources — Batch 35 (50 Countries)
scope: 50 candidate development-finance, SME finance, credit-guarantee and export-finance sources across 50 countries.
source_policy: Catalog candidates only; not verified live integrations or confirmation of funding eligibility.
Manually validate current official URLs, programme status, eligibility, geographic coverage, terms, fees, deadlines and application requirements.
A listed institution does not guarantee funding approval or access by foreign-owned or Sudan-based applicants.
Distinguish grants, loans, guarantees, export credit, equity and advisory services; these are not interchangeable.
API availability and licensing are not assessed. Use data only under source terms and applicable law.
HTTP 403, anti-bot responses and timeouts are not by themselves evidence that a URL is broken.
